description.fun: Phione hatches from Eggs laid by Manaphy, yet it never grows into one, and nobody fully understands how the two are related: Manaphy are born on cold seafloors, Phione drift in warm seas. When the water warms, packs of Phione inflate the floats on their heads and drift lazily together, and however far they roam, they always return to where they were born.
description.guide: Phione is a Water-type Mythical Pokémon that hatches from Eggs laid by Manaphy or other Phione, but it does not evolve into Manaphy. It drifts in warm seas using the flotation sac on its head and always returns to its birthplace.
description.tagline: Manaphy's warm-water offspring that can never become Manaphy.

description.fun: Manaphy, the 'Prince of the Sea', is born on a cold seafloor and will swim great distances to return there. Its body is 80% water, which makes it very sensitive to its surroundings, and it is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any Pokémon. Oddly for a Mythical Pokémon it can breed, but its Eggs only ever hatch into Phione.
description.guide: Manaphy is a Water-type Mythical Pokémon designed by Ken Sugimori. It is born on cold seafloors, is 80% water, and has the power to bond with any Pokémon. It can breed, but its offspring are always Phione.
description.tagline: The Prince of the Sea, born to bond with anyone.
